parsed.note_claim: Hoyle was a corrections officer in Butler County Ohio sheriff's office before becoming a deputy in 2025.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Kinlee Hoyle never expected her life to change the day she walked into work at the Butler County Sheriff's Office, where she was serving as a corrections officer.
parsed.reason: The page confirms Hoyle worked as a corrections officer prior to attending the 2025 police academy and becoming a deputy.
